{{Quote|Ebe Endocott has come out of nowhere to challenge the best Podracers today. This confident Triffian boasts ''three'' semi-pro titles on Malastare.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Beed Annodue]]|audio=EbeEndocottAnnounce.flac|<ref name="EIR">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
'''Ebe E. Endocott''', [[Esquire]], was a [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who operated around and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. A former deliveryman on his [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]], Endocott was known for his daredevil stunts, and eventually found an extra outlet for his thrill seeking through the sport of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]]. Purchasing a pair [[J930 Dash-8 engine|J930 ''Dash''-8]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and a matching [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], Endocott went on to win three consecutive championships on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], which granted a massive boost to his growing ego.

Endocott was also popular on the planet [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]], where he excelled at the popular [[Fire Mountain Rally/Legends|Fire Mountain Rally]] racecourse. He eventually felt a heated desire to defeat the crafty and vicious opponent [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] pilot who was both a notorious cheater as well as one of Malastare's favorite pilots. Endocott raced against Sebulba during the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], finishing in fourth place. Sebulba, however, failed to finish at all, having crashed during the race's third lap.

==Biography==
===Endocott's early career===
{{Quote|Bolt Dud ''[sic]'' and Ebe Endocott seem to be having words in the pit. Ha ha ha. There's no love lost between these two!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
[[File:EbeEEndocott-SWAnakinsSpeedway.jpg|thumb|left|219x219px|Ebe E. Endocott was a Podracer.]]
Ebe E. Endocott was a [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]]<ref name="DB" /> who worked as a deliveryman who employed unorthodox daredevil tactics to make his deliveries. On Triffis, a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] accident left Endocott with a scar across his abdomen.<ref name="EVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The thrill-seeker soon found a more suitable output for his piloting skills in the form of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] racing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]],<ref name="NEGC" /> which was popular on the planet. However, looking to score higher victory purses, the Triffian's [[Ebe E. Endocott's personal clerk|personal clerk]] recommended that Endocott take up [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] instead, which Endocott agreed to.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Podracing was a popular sport at the time where a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] was pulled along by two [[Engine/Legends|engines]] at high speeds through hazardous courses.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> 

Purchasing a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[JAK Racing]] [[J930 Dash-8 engine|J930 ''Dash''-8]] racer, known for its excellent traction, Endocott's early career was focused on the [[Semipro Podracing Circuit]], where he won three championships on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]<ref name="DB" /> and become the track favorite on one of Malastare's [[Malastare drag course 4|drag courses]].<ref name="GBC">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']] {{C|Gameboy Color version}}</ref> He even dominated Malastare's difficult [[Dug Derby/Legends|Dug Derby]] racecourse.<ref name="Nint">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref> High on his victories, the cocky Triffian purchased a brand new [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in order to transport his ''Dash''-8 from race to race.<ref name="DB" /> He achieved further victory on [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]], where he became the track favorite for the [[Fire Mountain Rally/Legends|Fire Mountain Rally]] racecourse.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

===The Boonta Eve Classic===
{{Quote|Congratulations, Ebe! Can I buy you a ruby bliel?&raquo;<br />&laquo;Thanks, Quadinaros! So, how much money did you win from Boles Roor?|translated=1|Ben Quadinaros and Ebe Endocott after finishing the Boonta Eve Classic|<ref name="PT">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
[[File:Boonta_Eve_Podracers.png|thumb|right|381x381px|Endocott participated in the Boonta Eve Classic.]]
Around this time, Endocott began to develop an intense desire to defeat the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], another well-known champion from Malastare. The Triffian believed that the Dug's winning days were over and thought that he could unseat Sebulba as Malastare's media favorite.<ref name="DB" /> Endocott and Sebulba both participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Upon the arrival of the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|race]], Endocott's Podracer, towed by a hardy [[Dewback/Legends|Dewback]],<ref name="EEP">{{DB|vehicle|ebeendocottspodracer|Podracer, Ebe Endocott's}}</ref> was placed on the outside pole position of the third row, next to the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]] and behind the [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]],<ref name="TPM" /> who unbeknownst to Endocott was working as Sebulba's secret on-track [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]].<ref name="PT" />

[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the race's host, officially started the race off, and pilots roared off into the desert, with the exception of two&mdash;the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]. Both racers had stalled on the starting grid, though Skywalker was able to continue after readjusting his Pod.<ref name="TPM" /> Quadinaros on the other hand never left the grid due to being unintentionally sabotaged by the [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] contestant [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]].<ref name="PT" />

As the race moved along, Sebulba took to the lead early on, besting the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] pilot [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]] during the first stretch of the race through [[Mushroom Mesa/Legends|Mushroom Mesa]]. Endocott however began to fall far behind, ending up behind the main pack. At the start of the second lap, he had been passed up by Anakin Skywalker, and the two pilots roared across the grid together into the second lap. Skywalker was eventually able to overcome the pack leaders and best Sebulba during the final stretch of the third lap and as such win the Boonta.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Ebe_Endocott_Podracing_Tales.png|thumb|left|265x265px|Ben Quadinaros congratulates Ebe on his fourth-place finish.]]
Endocott overall placed fourth, behind the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]],<ref name="PT" /> unwittingly preventing [[Kam Nale|Elan Mak]] from shooting the Glymphid.<ref name="NEGC" /> Despite not winning the race, the Triffian took consolation in the fact that Sebulba did not place at all, as the cheating Dug had crashed after his tangle with Skywalker while speeding through [[Hutt Flats/Legends|Hutt Flats]].<ref name="DB" /> Quadinaros later congratulated Endocott for his fourth-place finish, offering to buy him a [[ruby bliel]],<ref name="PT" /> a gooey drink sold on Tatooine.<ref name="Ruby">{{CSWECite|III|113|ruby bilel}}</ref>

===Endocott's continued career===
{{Quote|You need to go back to racing school.|Ebe E. Endocott taunting another pilot|translated=1|audio=EbeEndocott-taunt.flac|<ref name="EIR" />}}
By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HNNDate">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51||What to Scan}} is set in 13:4:11 on the [[Great ReSynchronization]] calendar&mdash;thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after its starting point in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]]&mdash;which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Endocott was still active on the track and had attained the honorary title of [[Esquire]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|regional/13411_1.html|Moe Funeral Disrupted by Dug Activists}}</ref> Ebe Endocott continued his career throughout 22 BBY, racing against many of his old foes including Gasgano, Ark Roose, and Elan Mak. Sebulba, whom Endocott had once shared a one-sided rivalry with, was no longer racing, however, having instead retired. Sebulba still operated a Podracing team known as [[Team Sebulba]], where Aldar Beedo acted as Sebulba's pilot. The new Podracing circuit started on Tatooine, but expanded to other worlds as well, including the jungle planet of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] located on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], the [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] world of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="KSW">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Endocott.jpg|thumb|right|239x239px|Endocott had a scarred abdomen.]]
The daring Ebe E. Endocott believed himself to be one of the best of the best. After his victories on Malastare, Endocott developed a brash over-confidence that perused him to purchase an expensive Corellian freighter.<ref name="DB" /> High on his success, Endocott raced on Baroonda<ref name="Prima" /> and achieved further fame that caused him to fantasize about unseating Sebulba as the poster child of Malastare Podracing. With new goals set, Endocott became driven to beat Sebulba. While he didn't place first during the Boonta, he decided that placing at all, whereas Sebulba crashed, was victory enough.<ref name="DB" />

A Triffian, Endocott's [[Limb/Legends|arms and legs]] were covered with blue, cream, and black colored [[Hair/Legends|fur]], as well parts of his body and his tail. His scarred<ref name="EVD" /> abdomen had light colored skin, while his face, framed by two large upward-curving fur-covered flaps, was a mix of white, blue, and yellow. He had a small blue and yellow beak, and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He stood 1.22 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="DB" />

==Skills and abilities==
Ebe E. Endocott was known for his ego and boasting, yet he was not one who could not live up to his boasts. Endocott had the agility and reflexes to participate in Podracing, and took home numerous trophies, including three consecutive championships on Malastare.<ref name="DB" /> Before that, he was a skilled speeder pilot on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as well as on Boonta. However, as proved during his daredevil delivery stunts, he was not invincible, having suffered an accident that left him with a large scar across his stomach.<ref name="EVD" /> During the Boonta Eve Classic, Endocott managed to place in fourth, ahead of other more seasoned pilots, including the track favorite Sebulba, who had failed to finish at all.<ref name="PT" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Endocott_pod.jpg|thumb|left|305x305px|Ebe Endocott's J930 ''Dash''-8 Podracer.]]
When Ebe Endocott left Boonta to pursue Podracing, he used a<ref name="NEGC" /> modified<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|235|Endocott, Ebe}}</ref> JAK Racing J930 ''Dash''-8 Podracer.<ref name="NEGC" /> The ''Dash''-8 was renowned for its traction and handling, that allowed Endocott a surplus of control over the vehicle, which was especially useful for the twisty courses of Baroonda<ref name="EIR" /> and Malastare where he was most popular.<ref name="DB" /> The [[Cockpit/Legends|acceleration chair]] was set high<ref name="EVD" /> enough for Endocott to see clear over the engines for any obstacles,<ref name="EIR" /> though as his career flourished, he also enjoyed the cockpit's height for the extra exposure it would grant him to his adoring fans.<ref name="Nint" /> The Pod's color scheme was predominantly blue, with red details on the [[Engine/Legends|engine's]] fins and on the rear of the engine casings. Parts of the engine's rear sides were also white. The cockpit was blue overall, matching the engines, though the front and the underside of the cockpit were red.<ref name="EIR" /> The cockpit was 3.05 meters in length, while each engine was 9.55 meters long.<ref name="EEP" />

After several victories on Malastare, Endocott bought himself a Corellian freighter that he used to transport his Podracer from planet to planet.<ref name="NEGC" /> When racing, Ebe Endocott employed a full set of piloting gear including a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Clothing/Legends|coat]] with gold trimming and red pants. He also wore several gold necklaces.<ref name="EIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CAEE_5.jpg|thumb|255x255px|right|Concept art of Endocott by Terryl Whitlatch]]
Ebe E. Endocott first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], a [[1999]] film directed by [[George Lucas]]. Endocott was realized in the film as a low resolution digital model that could be seen in the cockpit of Endocott's Podracer, as well seen outside of the Podracer on a view-screen behind Fode and Beed. A far more detailed sculpt of the character was also built by the art department. Endocott was created by concept artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]], who provided several pieces of artwork for Endocott. Whitlatch designed the character with a large face-framing frill, which helped the character dissipate excess heat when unfurled.<ref name="DB" /> Some early art portrayed Endocott to much larger, and also much skinnier, than his final design.<ref name="IG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> Endocott's digital model was reused for the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], where the model was used to represent a Triffian named [[Ony Bobissia]] who appeared outside of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. Endocott's model was one of several retooled Podracer models used in ''Attack of the Clones''.<ref name="Dex">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref>

Endocott also appeared in the 1999 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', which was released on the [[May 19|same day]] as the ''The Phantom Menace'', where he was voiced by [[Roger Jackson]], who was also responsible for voicing Ark "Bumpy" Roose in the game.<ref name="EIR" /> Endocott later appeared in the [[2012]] video game ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', where he served as an opponent to the player during Podraces. The player could also use Endocott's Podracer to race in.<ref name="KSW" /> In addition to these video games, Endocott was also set to appear in 2002's ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', a sequel to the earlier ''Episode I Racer''. Although voice lines were recorded for the character, Endocott was ultimately cut from the game. His voice files and other references to his involvement can still be found in the game's files, however.<ref name="RR">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'' game files</ref> Ebe Endocott did not receive his middle initial of E. until an [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />
